name: ListCert

parameters.help_en: Filters certificates modified before this date
parameters.name: before_date

parameters.help_en: Filters certificates modified after this date
parameters.name: after_date

parameters.help_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:

ISSUE: Active

REVOKE: Revoked
parameters.help_zh:
证书状态。取值：

ISSUE：正常。
REVOKE：已吊销
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

SERVER: Server certificate

CLIENT: Client certificate

END_ENTITY: End-entity certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。取值：

SERVER：服务端证书。
CLIENT：客户端证书。
END_ENTITY：终端证书
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_zh: 证书的总大小。单位：字节
parameters.name: show_size

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. This is the NextToken value from a previous response. If unspecified, the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the intermediate CA that issued the certificate
parameters.help_zh: CA标识。标识签发证书的中间CA
parameters.name: parent_identifier

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate

AfterTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the client certificate. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

The BeforeTime and AfterTime parameters must be both left empty or both specified
AfterTime.description_zh:
客户端证书的服务到期时间，使用时间戳格式。单位：毫秒。
BeforeTime和AfterTime参数必须同时为空或者同时设置

BeforeDate.description_en: The issuance time of the certificate

BeforeTime.description_en:
The issuance time of the client certificate. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

The BeforeTime and AfterTime parameters must be both left empty or both specified
BeforeTime.description_zh:
客户端证书的签发时间，使用时间戳格式，默认为您调用该接口的时间。单位：毫秒。

BeforeTime和AfterTime参数必须同时为空或者同时设置

CertificateType.description_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

`free`: Free certificate.

`cas`: Alibaba Cloud Security certificate.

`upload`: A user-uploaded certificate
CertificateType.description_zh:
证书类型。取值：

free：免费证书。
cas：云盾证书。
upload：自定义上传

CommonName.description_en: The primary domain name of the certificate

CustomIdentifier.description_en: A unique, user-defined identifier for the certificate
CustomIdentifier.description_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键

Extra.description_en: A JSON string containing extended attributes

Id.description_en: The ID of the data source to which the certificate order belongs

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the certificate

KeyExportable.description_en:
Specifies if the private key is exportable. Valid values:

`true`: The private key is exportable.

`false`: The private key is not exportable
KeyExportable.description_zh:
是否可以使用该证书。取值：

true：可以使用。
false：不可以使用

Organization.description_en: The organization specified in the certificate

OrganizationUnit.description_en: The organizational unit (OU) specified in the certificate
OrganizationUnit.description_zh: 购买证书的用户所属的公司或组织名称

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:

`ISSUE`: Issued.

`REVOKE`: Revoked
Status.description_zh:
证书状态。取值：

ISSUE：正常。
REVOKE：已吊销

SubjectDn.description_en: The distinguished name (DN) of the certificate subject

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量

NextToken.description_en: A token to retrieve the next page of results. If this value is empty, all results have been returned
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个

ShowSize.description_zh: 证书的总大小。单位：字节
